verdict.rationale: Square's Terminal API documents collecting tips at checkout on the terminal, including a separate tip input screen before the buyer's signature and custom tip amounts. That covers the core of tipping prompts collected on Square hardware. The evidence does not show configurable tip percentages or smart tip amounts, and the only source is a single developer-API doc line. missing for 10: configurable percentage tip options, smart tip amounts, merchant-facing (non-API) tip configuration, reader-specific tipping evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
